metadata.formula: PPR_tC = catch_t * saved classic wet-weight-equivalent SPPR / 9; if coefficient absent but saved TL present, TE**(1-TL); divide by 9 exactly once. Recorded zero catch gives zero contribution even with missing coefficient.
